mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2%, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in a relatively strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in strong labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a single month signals strong labor demand, which can lead to wage inflation and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM < 0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals strong demand in the housing market, which can boost related sectors and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST MoM > 10%.
